title: The Discipline of Technical Vocabulary
text:
Mastery of a specialist field is rarely demonstrated by the accumulation of arcane terminology alone. A practitioner must deploy jargon with precision, recognising when a term illuminates a distinction and when it merely obscures a simple observation. Many novices mistake density of technical vocabulary for expertise, producing prose that is impenetrable to outsiders yet vague to colleagues. The distinction is subtle but consequential.

Experienced specialists, by contrast, tend to employ terminology sparingly and with evident economy. They reserve the more esoteric terms for moments when a precise concept genuinely requires them, and they translate those terms for the uninitiated without condescension. Such fluency is acquired gradually, through sustained exposure to the discourse of a discipline. It is less a matter of memorisation than of learning to think within the conventions that the vocabulary encodes.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what is rarely a sign of mastery in a specialist field?
options: The accumulation of arcane terminology alone
Writing for an audience of colleagues

questions.text: According to paragraph two, how do experienced specialists tend to use terminology?
options: They employ it frequently and without restraint
They reserve esoteric terms for when they are genuinely required
They use it only when writing for other specialists

questions.text: What can be inferred about novices from paragraph one?
options: They understand technical concepts better than experts do
They tend to confuse dense jargon with genuine expertise
They write prose that is clear to everyone
They avoid using any specialist vocabulary

questions.text: What is the main idea the passage implies about acquiring specialist fluency?
options: It depends mainly on memorising long lists of terms
It develops through immersion in a discipline's discourse and its underlying way of thinking
It can be achieved quickly through formal instruction alone
It is unnecessary for communicating with colleagues

paragraph_translations: O domínio de uma área especializada raramente se demonstra apenas pelo acúmulo de terminologia arcana. Um profissional deve empregar o jargão com precisão, reconhecendo quando um termo esclarece uma distinção e quando apenas obscurece uma observação simples. Muitos iniciantes confundem a densidade de vocabulário técnico com competência, produzindo textos impenetráveis para os leigos e vagos para os colegas. A distinção é sutil, mas tem consequências importantes.

Especialistas experientes, por outro lado, tendem a empregar a terminologia com moderação e evidente economia. Reservam os termos mais esotéricos para os momentos em que um conceito preciso realmente os exige, e os traduzem para os não iniciados sem condescendência. Essa fluência é adquirida gradualmente, por meio de exposição contínua ao discurso de uma disciplina. Trata-se menos de memorização do que de aprender a pensar dentro das convenções que o vocabulário encerra.
